text: [excited] Google built a whole fake internet... just to trick its own AI!
Hundreds of fake websites. Shops, checkouts, social feeds.
Then they sent in their AI shopper... [whispers] and hid traps everywhere. In the text, in pictures, in invisible labels.
[mischievously] The goal: catch it getting fooled.
[deadpan] One problem. The AI noticed the weird web addresses... and got suspicious.
[laughs] Google admits its models are far too perceptive. So the traps went deeper.
[playfully] Would you let an AI shop for you? Send this to the friend who clicks every link.
